description: Metadata responses (spec 6, 7.2), verified against the entry in keys.json. `request` is the path the client asked for; `document` is the response body as text. A valid case gives `jcs`, the signed octets, and `expect`, some of the members read; an invalid case gives the `error` kind. Keys are RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1 (the resolver) and TEST 2 (a foreign key). Their secret keys are published: examples and tests only.

error_kinds.json: not an I-JSON object: malformed, duplicate member names, numbers beyond double precision, integers (numbers written without fraction or exponent) above 2^53 in magnitude, lone surrogates
error_kinds.key: sig.kid names no key in the entry
error_kinds.schema: a member breaks spec 6.1 or the Appendix A schema
error_kinds.publisher: publisher.number differs from the publisher number of id
error_kinds.id: id differs from the id requested
error_kinds.version: version differs from the pinned version requested

cases.name: unknown members are signed and ignored
